items.text: How do I check the status of my transfer?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

To check your transfer's status, log into your Wise account, go to Home to see your activity list, and click on the specific transfer you want to track. Once logged in, you'll see statuses like "Your money's being processed" or "Transfer Sent," which tell you exactly where your money is in the system. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: When will my money arrive?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

Your money should arrive within the estimated time we gave you when you set up the transfer. If it's taking longer, delays can happen because your bank is sending us the money, we're processing it, or the recipient's bank is still working on it. Weekends and public holidays also slow things down since banks don't process transfers then.

Want to know more about your specific situation?

items.text: Why does it say my transfer is complete when the money hasn't arrived?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

We mark your transfer as complete once we have sent the money to your recipient's bank. The remaining time allows their bank to process and release the funds, which can take up to one working day. If you still don't see it, ask them to check for a different sender name or currency conversion, and provide a transfer receipt if needed. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Why is my transfer taking longer than the estimate?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

Delays can happen if your bank takes time to send money, security checks are needed, or there's a mistake in recipient details. Weekends and holidays also slow things down since banks don't process transfers then. Your recipient might need to ask their bank for help using a transfer receipt. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What is a proof of payment?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

A proof of payment is a document showing you've sent money from your bank account. It could be a PDF of your bank statement, a screenshot from your online bank, or other file types less than 10MB and up to five files per altogether. We might ask for this if your money hasn't reached us in the expected time frame or if we need to verify it came from an account in your name. To accept it, the document must clearly show your details, your bank's name, our details, the date, amount, currency, and reference number.

items.text: What's a banking partner reference number?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

For every transfer you send with Wise, we give you a transfer number to use if you need to get in touch with us. For some transfers, we also provide a banking partner reference number because we send your money through local banking partners in each country. You should give this number to your recipient so they can track the transfer once it shows as completed on your Wise account. They may need to share it with their bank if there are any issues.

Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: The app says due today but my sister hasn't got anything yet.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

If the app says your money is due today, it should have arrived already because some banks need hours to process transfers from us. Your sister might not see it yet if her bank is still processing it or if there's a delay with her account currency. She can check her bank statement for Wise or ask her bank to speed up the process using a transfer receipt. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: It's been stuck on 'your money's being processed' for three days.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

If your transfer has been on "Your money's being processed" for more than two working days, you should check with your bank to ensure they have sent the funds to us. Banks may take time to process incoming payments, especially if there are delays or issues with the payment method used.

Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: My landlord says he can't see the payment but Wise shows it as done.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

Wise marks your transfer complete once we've sent the money to your recipient's bank, but their bank may still be processing it or converting the currency. Your landlord should check their bank statement for a transaction from Wise using the reference number provided in your receipt, as they might not see your name on it. They can also verify if their account currency matches what was sent, which could affect the final amount. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: How long does a Swift transfer take to get to you?

llm.label: out
llm.reply: OUT

items.text: You emailed asking me for proof I sent the money. What do I need to send?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

To provide proof of payment, you need to upload a high-quality screenshot or PDF of your bank statement showing your name, account number, and the transaction details including the date, amount, currency, and reference. For Swift payments, specifically an pacs.008 document is required. We cannot accept text copied from emails or photos of computer screens.

items.text: What's a UTR number?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

A UTR is the Unique Transaction Reference number your bank uses for transfers from India. It is the same as the banking partner reference number Wise gives you. Give this number to your recipient so they can track where their money is with their bank. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: I sent it on Friday afternoon and it still hasn't landed.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

Transfers sent before Friday evening may not process until the next working day because banks are closed on weekends. Your money is likely still in our system waiting for the recipient's bank to open. Check your tracker again tomorrow morning to see if it has arrived. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: I spelled the recipient's name slightly wrong, will the money still get there?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

Small typos in names usually don't stop your transfer from arriving on time. However, for some currencies like Japanese Yen, even small spelling errors can cause issues. If something is wrong with an account number, your money might take longer or get sent back to us. We'll let you know immediately if that happens. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Can a screenshot from my banking app count as proof?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

Yes, a high-quality screenshot from your online banking app can count as proof of payment if it clearly shows your name, account number, bank details, the date, amount, currency, and reference. It must not be copied text or a photo of a screen.

items.text: My recipient got less money than I sent, why?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

Your recipient's bank may have converted the currency again, resulting in a different amount than expected. They might also receive a slightly different sum if their account is in a different currency than what you sent.

items.text: Is there anything I can do to make it arrive faster?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER

If your transfer has been sent but hasn't arrived yet, the quickest way is to give your recipient a transfer receipt. This PDF document contains all the payment details their bank needs to track and process the money. You can get this by logging into your Wise account, clicking on your transfer, and downloading the receipt from the menu options.

Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Why are you doing a security check on my transfer?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
ANSWER
We run extra checks to keep your money safe as part of our standard procedure for regulated financial institutions. If we need more information from you, like ID or proof of where the money came from, we'll send you an email explaining what we need. We can't speed up these checks, but we work as fast as we can. Anything else about your transfer?
